name: code-xr-ide
description: Code-XR IDE: a desktop environment (Electron + Monaco) to edit, analyse and explore code in XR.

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/coreTypes.mjs && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.web.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
